summary: A discussion of how to make connections between minicomputer-based terminals and a TIP more reliable. The existing protocol sends one character at a time with no error control, assuming a human can spot errors. That assumption fails for faster or automated terminals, so the author raises ways to detect and correct errors.

eli5.summary: A person can notice a typo when reading, but a machine cannot. This note says the connection needs a way to check for mistakes, because no human will spot them.
